attempts.summary: Blacklisted the usb-storage kernel module on node1 (RHEL 10) via /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf using both `blacklist` and `install .../bin/false` directives, rebuilt the initramfs with dracut so the block applies at early boot, and verified modprobe refuses to load the module both before and after a full node reboot (with confirmed boot_id change proving the restart).
